header.title: ORBYT
header.tagline: AI Visual Studio · We render the impossible — cinema-grade shots and motion for brands moving at the speed of AI.

faq.q: Is this real photography or AI?
faq.a: Both worlds, the best of each. We create with the leading AI tools, but a human director frames, lights, and reviews every shot. You get studio-grade polish without the studio logistics.

faq.q: How fast do I get my shots?
faq.a: A single product shoot is delivered in 48 hours. Larger campaigns are scoped to your launch date and usually land in a few days, not weeks.

faq.q: How many revisions do I get?
faq.a: We refine until the frames are right for your brand. Revision rounds are included in every package.

faq.q: What formats and sizes do you deliver?
faq.a: Every aspect ratio your channels need: 1:1 and 4:5 for feed, 9:16 for reels and stories, 16:9 for landing pages and YouTube. High-resolution exports, ready to post.

faq.q: Do I own the images? Can I run them in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. You receive full commercial usage rights for the visuals we deliver, cleared for organic and paid campaigns.

faq.q: What do you need from me to start?
faq.a: Your product details, any brand assets or references, and a sentence on the vibe you want. That is enough for us to build the shot list and get moving.
We confirm the quote on WhatsApp, take a deposit to start, and settle the balance on delivery.
